# Contributing

For the rules and the pull request process, see [Contributing](/docs/dev/contributing.md). To use RadioFoundry in
another project, see [Using RadioFoundry in your project](/FORKING.md). Report security problems as
[SECURITY.md](/.github/SECURITY.md) describes, not in a public issue.
